title: Expose Business Value page across the site
description: As a technical buyer, exec, or investor, I want to easily find the Business Value page and understand how DaemonCore’s mechanisms translate into outcomes, so I can justify adoption and de-risk deployment.
acceptance_criteria: Business Value page is reachable via primary nav and footer.
Home page ‘Get Started’ includes a Business Value CTA card linking to the page.
Kernel and Why Different pages include at least one CTA link to Business Value.
Copy avoids overclaiming: V1 does not claim model-level prompt injection prevention; V1.5 claims are explicitly marked planned.
